title: Realistic daily schedule
scope: Supplied calendar and duration estimates; no live calendar

phases.prompt:
Review the 09:00–17:00 working day. Overlaps occupy time only once. Report conflicts as pairs of event IDs, available_minutes, known_task_minutes, unknown_duration_ids, and over_capacity (known durations exceed available time). Do not invent durations. Explain how I should adjust my workload.
Save the requested structured facts in outputs/result.json, as valid JSON with
exactly the documented fields. IDs refer to the supplied input records. Use
JSON null for unknown values; do not guess. Also save a useful human-readable
outputs/report.md (at least 80 characters). Check the final files before finishing.
The report's existence is checked, but its prose quality is not automatically scored.
